title: Already heard
setting: Evening at home. Okaasan gets back late from the shops after a long chat with Satou-san next door, just as Kenji has some news of his own.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.ja: お母さん、帰り遅かったね。
lines.kana: おかあさん、かえりおそかったね。

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: gomen ne. kaimono no kaeri ni, satou-san to hanashi o shiteta no.
lines.ja: ごめんね。買い物の帰りに、佐藤さんと話をしてたの。
lines.kana: ごめんね。かいもののかえりに、さとうさんとはなしをしてたの。
lines.english: Sorry. On my way back from the shops, I got talking with Satou-san.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: satou-san ka. hanashi nagai yo ne.
lines.ja: 佐藤さんか。話長いよね。
lines.kana: さとうさんか。はなしながいよね。
lines.english: Satou-san, huh. He does go on, doesn't he.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: honto ni ne. ichijikan, zutto hanashi kiiteta no yo.
lines.ja: ほんとにね。一時間、ずっと話聞いてたのよ。
lines.kana: ほんとにね。いちじかん、ずっとはなしきいてたのよ。
lines.english: Tell me about it. I was listening to him for a whole hour.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: ichijikan? nan no hanashi shiteta no?
lines.ja: 一時間？何の話してたの？
lines.kana: いちじかん？なんのはなししてたの？
lines.english: An hour? What were you talking about?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: fuun. a, okaasan, chotto hanashi ga aru n da kedo.
lines.ja: ふーん。あ、お母さん、ちょっと話があるんだけど。
lines.kana: ふーん。あ、おかあさん、ちょっとはなしがあるんだけど。
lines.english: Huh. Oh, Mum, there's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: hanashi ga aru tte, nani? nagai hanashi?
lines.ja: 話があるって、何？長い話？
lines.kana: はなしがあるって、なに？ながいはなし？
lines.english: Something to tell me? What is it? Is it a long one?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: uun. boku, satou-san ja nai kara, hanashi nagaku nai yo.
lines.ja: ううん。僕、佐藤さんじゃないから、話長くないよ。
lines.kana: ううん。ぼく、さとうさんじゃないから、はなしながくないよ。
lines.english: Nope. I'm not Satou-san. I don't go on and on.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: hai hai. jaa, hanashi kiku yo.
lines.ja: はいはい。じゃあ、話聞くよ。
lines.kana: はいはい。じゃあ、はなしきくよ。
lines.english: Yeah, yeah. Go on then, I'm listening.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: ano ne, boku, kanojo ga dekita n da.
lines.ja: あのね、僕、彼女ができたんだ。
lines.kana: あのね、ぼく、かのじょができたんだ。
lines.english: So, um... I've got a girlfriend.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: a, sono hanashi, mou kiita yo.
lines.ja: あ、その話、もう聞いたよ。
lines.kana: あ、そのはなし、もうきいたよ。

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: satou-san kara. kami ga nagakute, se ga takai ko da yo ne?
lines.ja: 佐藤さんから。髪が長くて、背が高い子だよね？
lines.kana: さとうさんから。かみがながくて、せがたかいこだよね？
lines.english: From Satou-san. Long hair, tall, right?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: jaa, ichijikan mo boku no hanashi shiteta no?
lines.ja: じゃあ、一時間も僕の話してたの？
lines.kana: じゃあ、いちじかんもぼくのはなししてたの？
lines.english: Wait, so you spent a whole hour talking about me?

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: un. sorede ne, okaasan kara mo hanashi ga aru no.
lines.ja: うん。それでね、お母さんからも話があるの。
lines.kana: うん。それでね、おかあさんからもはなしがあるの。
lines.english: Yep. And so, I've got something to talk to you about too.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: ee, nagai hanashi? okaasan, hanashi nagai kara naa.
lines.ja: えー、長い話？お母さん、話長いからなあ。
lines.kana: えー、ながいはなし？おかあさん、はなしながいからなあ。
lines.english: Oh no, is it a long one? You do go on, Mum.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: nagai yo. sono ko no hanashi, zenbu kiku kara ne.
lines.ja: 長いよ。その子の話、全部聞くからね。
lines.kana: ながいよ。そのこのはなし、ぜんぶきくからね。
lines.english: A long one. I want to hear everything about this girl.

choices.english: Mum got back late from Satou-san's, and she's too tired to hear Kenji's news tonight.
Kenji tells Mum he has a girlfriend, and Mum says she'll pass the news on to Satou-san.
Kenji tells Mum he has a girlfriend, but she already knew: Satou-san told her during their hour-long chat.

questions.explanation: Line 11: Kenji's news is kanojo ga dekita (he's got a girlfriend). Line 12: Mum has already heard about it (sono hanashi, mou kiita yo), and line 14 says who from: satou-san kara, who even described the girl (long hair, tall). Line 15: so the hour Mum spent with Satou-san (lines 2-5) was about Kenji (ichijikan mo boku no hanashi shiteta no?). Lines 16-18: now Mum has her own talk for him: she wants to hear all about the girl. A is wrong: Mum isn't too tired; she says she'll listen (line 10: hanashi kiku yo) and wants to hear everything (line 18). B is wrong: the news went the other way, from Satou-san to Mum (line 14).

questions.english: You and Mum have been chatting about your little brother Kenji. He wanders in and asks, "nani? nani shiteta no?" (What? What were you two doing?) Tell him you were talking about him.
questions.answer: Say who you were talking about with X no hanashi shiteta, using his name for X: kenji no hanashi shiteta no.

modelAnswers.romaji: kenji no hanashi o shiteta n da yo.
modelAnswers.ja: ケンジの話をしてたんだよ。
modelAnswers.english: We were talking about you, actually.

questions.explanation: Hanashi o suru takes the topic in front with no: X no hanashi shiteta = we were talking about X. Kenji asks it this way in line 5 (nan no hanashi shiteta no?) and line 15 (boku no hanashi shiteta no?). Casual speech drops o once hanashi has a word in front of it, as in the first model; the second keeps it and adds n da yo. Talking to Kenji, use his name rather than anata. The person you talked with goes with to: satou-san to hanashi o shiteta (line 2).

questions.english: When Kenji tells his mum he has a girlfriend, she says "a, sono hanashi, mou kiita yo." What does she mean?
questions.ja: お母さんは、何を聞いたんですか？
questions.kana: おかあさんは、なにをきいたんですか？
questions.romaji: okaasan wa, nani o kiita n desu ka?

choices.english: She had already heard the news, from Satou-san.
She had already asked Satou-san about Kenji's girlfriend.
She had heard enough and wanted Kenji to stop talking.

questions.explanation: Line 12: hanashi o kiku is hearing about something as well as listening: sono hanashi, mou kiita yo = I've already heard about that. Line 14 says who from: satou-san kara (X kara kiku = hear it from X). B is kiku's other meaning, ask, which would be satou-san ni kiita; and it was Satou-san doing the talking while Mum listened for an hour (line 4: zutto hanashi kiiteta). C is wrong: Mum isn't cutting Kenji off; she offered to listen in line 10 (hanashi kiku yo) and in line 18 she wants to hear all of it (zenbu kiku kara ne).

questions.english: You call your old friend Kenta because there's something serious you need to talk to him about. He picks up: "moshimoshi? nani?" (Hello? What's up?) Tell him you need to talk, and ask if now is a good time.
questions.answer: Open with chotto hanashi ga aru n da kedo, then ask ima ii?

modelAnswers.romaji: chotto hanashi ga aru n da kedo, ima ii?
modelAnswers.ja: ちょっと話があるんだけど、今いい？
modelAnswers.english: I need to talk to you. Got a minute?

modelAnswers.romaji: chotto ohanashi ga aru n desu kedo, ima ii desu ka?
modelAnswers.ja: ちょっとお話があるんですけど、今いいですか？
modelAnswers.english: There's something I'd like to talk to you about. Do you have a moment?

questions.explanation: The everyday opener for a serious talk is chotto hanashi ga aru n da kedo, trailing off with n da kedo, exactly as Kenji says it in line 7; Mum uses the same phrase in line 16 (hanashi ga aru no). English 'I need to talk to you' pulls toward hanasu hitsuyou ga aru, which sounds stiff and official. Ima ii? (is now OK?) is the usual follow-up. The second model is the polite version, for someone like Tanaka-san: ohanashi ga aru n desu kedo.

questions.english: Mum says she got back late because she was talking with Satou-san. What did Kenji say about Satou-san?
questions.ja: ケンジさんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: けんじさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: kenji-san wa nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Satou-san, huh. That's a long story, isn't it.
choices.romaji: satou-san ka. nagai hanashi da yo ne.

choices.english: Satou-san, huh. He does go on, doesn't he.
choices.romaji: satou-san ka. hanashi nagai yo ne.

choices.english: Satou-san, huh. He's loud, isn't he.
choices.romaji: satou-san ka. koe ookii yo ne.

questions.explanation: Line 3: X (wa) hanashi nagai, with ga dropped, is the stock grumble about a person who goes on and on. Kenji says it again about himself in line 9 (hanashi nagaku nai yo, I don't go on) and about Mum in line 17. A turns it round into nagai hanashi, which is one long talk or story: that's what Mum asks about Kenji's news in line 8 (nagai hanashi?) and Kenji asks about hers in line 17. It describes a talk, not a person, so it can't say Satou-san always goes on. C is a different complaint (koe ga ookii, he's loud); what kept Mum was how long he talked, a whole hour (line 4).

newWords.english: girlfriend (kanojo ga dekita = I've got a girlfriend)
girl, kid (sono ko = that girl; se ga takai ko = a tall girl)
too, also; after an amount, a whole (ichijikan mo = a whole hour)
quoting what was just said (hanashi ga aru tte, nani? = something to tell me? what?)
